defs.def: the process of learning the skills that you need to do a job 训练；培训

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP使用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究者更快地处理图像。

ex.s: Training and tools will be provided.
ex.t: 我们将提供培训和工具。

ex.s: It offers training for doctors.
ex.t: 它为医生提供培训。

ex.s: A swimmer training to win an Olympic medal.
ex.t: 一名为赢得奥运奖牌而训练的游泳运动员。

ex.s: Adapting himself to the intense training.
ex.t: 适应高强度训练。

ex.s: Instructors are passionate educators who are experts in their fields and have undergone training and a background check.
ex.t: 指导员是充满热情的教育工作者，是他们领域的专家，并经过了培训和背景调查。

ex.s: attend job trainingD. set up a new email account
ex.t: 参加工作培训 D. 建立一个新的邮箱账户

ex.s: Her notice included what kind of training she wanted to do, how many days a week and how many hours she wanted to spend on each session, and her age.
ex.t: 她的启事包括她想做哪种训练、每周几天、每次几小时，以及她的年龄。

ex.s: During the training stage, each dog was shown only the upper half or the lower half of the person’s face.
ex.t: 在训练阶段，每只狗只被展示了人脸的上半部分或下半部分。

ex.s: The researchers then tested the dogs’ ability to distinguish between human facial expressions by showing them the other half of the person’s face or images totally different from the ones used in training.
ex.t: 然后研究者通过给狗看那个人脸的另一半、或完全不同于训练所用图像，来测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: The study showed the animals had figured out how to apply what they learned about human faces during training to new faces in the testing stage.
ex.t: 研究表明，这些动物已经想出了如何把训练时学到的关于人脸的知识，运用到测试阶段的新面孔上。

ex.s: Diverse methods were adopted during training.
ex.t: 训练过程中采用了多种不同的方法。

ex.s: carry out hypnosis training
ex.t: 进行催眠培训

ex.s: You may pursue training, degrees, or increasing levels of responsibility at work.
ex.t: 你可以在工作中追求培训、学位或不断提高的责任层级。

ex.s: Training in communication skills．
ex.t: 沟通技巧培训．

ex.s: In some cases, it’s not so much the treatment of the animals on set in the studio that has activists worried; it’s the off-set training and living conditions that are raising concerns.
ex.t: 在某些情况下，让活动家担心的不一定是摄影棚内动物的待遇问题；而是场外的训练和生活条件引发了担忧。

ex.s: Which provides eight weeks of paid employment along with training.
ex.t: 该项目提供八周的带薪就业和培训。

ex.s: Summer Company provides students with hands-on business training and awards of up to $3,000 to start and run their own summer businesses.
ex.t: 夏季公司项目为学生提供实践性商业培训和最高3,000美元的奖励，用于创办和运营他们自己的暑期企业。

ex.s: It requires no training before employment.
ex.t: 就业前不需要培训。

ex.s: In 1942, he used the word as a training slogan for the 2nd Marine Raider Battalion during World War II.
ex.t: 1942年，他在二战期间将这个词用作第二海军陆战队突击营的训练口号。

ex.s: can receive quality signals           B. are in need of training
ex.t: 能接收到优质信号           B.需要培训

ex.s: So I kept working hard to support my teammates during our training.
ex.t: 所以我一直努力训练，在训练期间支持我的队友。

ex.s: In many countries, the elderly can receive free training in the use of computers, and learn how to correspond by email, how to send photos and voice messages, and how to use the Internet for shopping and other services.
ex.t: 在许多国家，老年人可以接受免费的电脑使用培训，学习如何通过电子邮件通信，如何发送照片和语音消息，以及如何使用互联网购物和获取其他服务。

ex.s: But she learnt to parachute by training hard in secret.
ex.t: 但她通过秘密训练学会了降落伞

ex.s: She added that she had a line of staff at her door wanting to take the training.
ex.t: 她补充说，门口排了一队员工想要参加这个培训。

ex.s: They should take further training.
ex.t: 他们应该接受进一步的培训。

defs.def: the process of preparing to take part in a sports competition by doing physical exercises （为参加体育比赛而进行的）训练，锻炼

ex.s: So, if your “ideal” self is a professional footballer, and your “actual” self isn’t, your “ought” self is the one that spends a lot of time training, exercising, and getting better at football.
ex.t: 所以，如果你的"理想"自我是一名职业足球运动员，而你的"现实"自我不是，那么你的"应然"自我就是那个花大量时间训练、锻炼、并提高足球水平的人。

ex.s: How can you write a good “seeking training partner” notice?
ex.t: 你如何写好一则"寻找锻炼伙伴"的启事？

ex.s: Any notice for a training partner should include such information.
ex.t: 任何寻找锻炼伙伴的启事都应包含此类信息。

ex.s: "We put healthy 70-year-olds through a yearlong exercise training program, and nothing happened to them at all."
ex.t: 我们让健康的70岁老人参加为期一年的锻炼计划，他们根本没有任何变化。

ex.s: Were now training for national competitions and hope to be champions one day, but my ultimate goal is to be an ice hockey teacher and help people learn to play this game.
ex.t: 现在正在接受全国比赛的训练，希望有一天能成为冠军，但我的最终目标是成为一名冰球老师，帮助人们学习打这场比赛。

ex.s: DX Sports Watch Are you looking for a sports watch that can help you keep track of your fitness and chart your training progress?
